text:
SEO grows like a lemon tree. Slow at first, then it gives every year.

Year one, a few sad lemons. Year three, you're handing bags to the neighbours.

Google works the same way. The first months bring a few calls. Keep at it and the map sends you work year after year.

A cafe owner in Scarborough asks if I can get her more Instagram followers.

I tell her I'm the wrong person for that.

What I do: get her cafe showing up on Google when someone nearby searches "cafe Scarborough".

Followers don't buy coffee. People nearby searching for coffee do.

Most owners pay for SEO without checking if it can work for their business.

The salesman never mentions that part. (Funny, that.)

Four checks you can run this week before you spend a cent:
https://gimsresults.com.au/post/can-my-business-benefit-from-seo
